note: REST Views Geo is a submodule of rest_views. It provides a field formatter 'geolocation_latlng_formatter_export' (class GeolocationLatLngExportFormatter, field type geolocation) that emits SerializedData(['lat'=>..., 'lng'=>...]), and a hook_views_data_alter() that adds a field_export serializable handler for geolocation_field handlers. It works only with the serializable (field_export) handler; requires rest_views + geolocation. No config/route/permissions/Drush/plugin types. Medium cases read the live plugin registry and a real view config; hard cases enable the submodule (verify the formatter is registered) and set the geo export formatter on a real REST export view config. View-config cases apply the formatter id to a serializable field entry (config-level, verified against views.view config).

evals.prompt: With the rest_views_geo submodule, how do I export a Geolocation field as latitude/longitude JSON in a Views REST Export, and what is the formatter called?
evals.expected_output: Add the geolocation field's serializable ((field_export)) handler and set its formatter to 'Export' (geolocation_latlng_formatter_export). It outputs {lat, lng} per value.

evals.prompt: Does the rest_views_geo export formatter work with any Views field handler, and what modules does the submodule require?
evals.expected_output: It only works with the serializable handler (plugin_id field_export) from the parent rest_views module. The submodule requires rest_views and the geolocation module.

evals.prompt: What data structure does the rest_views_geo formatter output for each value of a geolocation field?
evals.expected_output: It outputs a JSON object with 'lat' and 'lng' keys (SerializedData(['lat' => $item->lat, 'lng' => $item->lng])); multiple values become an array of such objects.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the registered field formatters and give the id of the export formatter that the rest_views_geo module provides for geolocation fields.
evals.expected_output: The rest_views_geo module provides the field formatter geolocation_latlng_formatter_export (provider rest_views_geo).

evals.prompt: This site has a REST Export view rvg_known that exports a field using a rest_views_geo formatter. Inspect the live view config and state which formatter (type) that field uses.
evals.expected_output: The rvg_known view's field uses plugin_id field_export with type geolocation_latlng_formatter_export.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the geolocation export field formatter available so a Views REST Export can serialize a Geolocation field as lat/lng, by enabling the appropriate rest_views submodule. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The rest_views_geo module is enabled (e.g. drush en rest_views_geo), so the field formatter geolocation_latlng_formatter_export is registered.

evals.prompt: The REST Export view rvg_task on this site has a serializable field that currently uses a plain formatter. Using rest_views_geo, set that field's formatter to the geolocation lat/lng export formatter and save it to the live view.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.rvg_task the field keeps plugin_id field_export and its type (formatter) is set to geolocation_latlng_formatter_export.
